title: Records written on the peer reach the primary
result: `sync-all-safe` pushed the registry from the primary only, so session (and now remembered) records written on the mini stayed there: 314 did (session-claude-opus-5-5 and -fable-5-1, some ollama). It now pulls `records/` from the peer with `--ignore-existing` before pushing; the 314 were pulled by hand the same day.
